'''Blade Flurry''' is a [[channelling]] [[melee]] [[attack]]. While channelling, Blade Flurry repeatedly attacks a random enemy in front of the player, also damaging enemies nearby the original target. When released, it will unleash an extra number of attacks equal to the stage reached.

==Skill functions and interactions==
* '''Stages''': Each attack, while channelling, applies a single stage that grants 25% more damage, up to 150% more damage total at 6th stage. Each stage will also add an extra attack to the release of Blade Flurry.
* '''[[Dual wielding]]''': The skill alternates between the main hand and the offhand for each hit.<ref name="CommunityFAQ"/>
* '''[[AoE|Area of effect]]''': Modifiers to area, such as {{il|Concentrated Effect Support}} and {{il|Increased Area of Effect Support}}, affect both the radius of the main hit and the radius of the explosion caused by it.
*'''Trigger supports''': While both {{il|Cast On Critical Strike Support}} and {{il|Cast while Channelling Support}} can support Blade Flurry independently, they won't work in tandem; neither will trigger.
*'''{{il|Multistrike Support}}''': Blade Flurry (and all [[channelled skill]]s) cannot be supported by Multistrike.
* '''Attack Swing''': This attack does not have an initial attack swing, as such, it attacks the moment the skill is used. This means attacks with {{il|General's Cry}} need only 5 attacks per second to obtain full 6 stages within a second of channelling.

==DPS Calculation==

BF produces highest dps when player channels to max stages and then releases immediately. Calculations are for the perfect channelling, actual damage will be a bit lower.

Calculating ideal dps:

{{math
|formula = DPS = gemBaseDmg \times gemBaseAps \times avgPerTick
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}

For 21 lvl gem :

{{math
|formula = DPS = 129\% \times 1.6 \times 4.125 = 851.4\%
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}

Adding quality adds ~0.6% more damage per quality. See detailed calculation section for how to factor in quality. A 21/20 gem would have ~12.1% more damage than a 21/0 gem :

{{math
|formula = DPS = 129\% \times 1.6 \times 4.625 = 954.6\%
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}

For 21 lvl gem with +1 max stage enchant:

{{math
|formula = DPS = 129\% \times 1.6 \times 4.5 = 928.8\%
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}


{{cot|Blade Flurry dps calculation}}

Current assumption is that strike calculates damage before updating stage bonus. So fist strike has 0 stage bonus, and n strike has n-1 stage bonus up to max. Release strikes happen after stage bonus has been updated, so they fully benefit from current stage bonus.

It is corroborated by Zrevnur's DPS test in the VERY OLD patch.
[https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/1773704/page/1#p13912777 "Blade Flurry vs Reave: 2.86x damage vs single target"]




{{math|N}} is number of channel ticks, which is less or equal to max stages.

{{math|S}} is number of stages before release, which is less or equal to max stages.

{{math|Q}} is quality.


Sum of multipliers from stages build up:

{{math
|formula = summChannel = N \times 0.5 \times (1 + (1 + (N-1) \times 0.25)) 
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}


Damage from release on current stages:

{{math
|formula = summRelease = S \times (1 + 0.25 \times S) \times (1 + 0.01 \times Q)
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}


Calculating average damage multiplier per channel tick with perfect release:

{{math
|formula = avgPerTick = {summChannel + summRelease \over N}
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}


For 6 max stages and 6 ticks:

{{math
|formula = {9.75 + 15 \over 6} = 4.125
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}


For 7 max stages(helm enchant) and 7 ticks:

{{math
|formula = {12.25 + 19.25 \over 7} = 4.5
|display = block
|indent = 1
}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.26.0|
* Blade Flurry: Now has 68.2-125.1% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem levels 1-20 (previously 60.6-111.2%), and now has 25% more Damage with Hits and Ailments for each Stage (previously 20%). Quality now provides 0-20% more Damage while at max Stages (previously 0-5% more Damage with Hits and Ailments for each stage).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
*  No longer has Added Attack Physical Damage at all gem levels.
* It now has 61% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 32%), scaling up to 111% at gem level 20 (previously 49%).
* Now has a Mana cost of 5 at gem level 1, scaling up to 6 at gem level 20 (previously 4 at all gem levels).
* The following Skills no longer have the Physical tag: '''Blade Flurry''', Blade Flurry of Incision, Cleave, Cleave of Rage, Cyclone, Cyclone of Tumult, Lancing Steel of Spraying, Perforate, Perforate of Duality, Shrapnel Ballista, Split Arrow, Sweep, Vaal Blade Flurry, Vaal Cleave, and Vaal Cyclone.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now provides +0-5% more Damage with Hits and Ailments for each stage, instead of 0-10% increased Attack Speed.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* Blade Flurry Helmet [[Enchantment]] that granted {{c|mod|chance to Dodge Attack Hits}} now grants {{c|mod|+1 Maximum Stages}}. 
* This affects existing items
}}
{{Version history table row|3.15.0|
* Now deals 49% of Base Damage, and has 49% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 20 (previously 45%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.7.0|
* Now deals base damage equal to, and has an added damage effectiveness of, 32% at gem level 1 (from 45%), up to 45% at gem level 20 (from 56%).
* Now adds 14 to 20 physical damage to attacks at gem level 1, up to 75 to 113 at gem level 20.
* Now has 29% larger target-acquiring radius while channelling, and 47% larger target-acquiring radius after channelling ends.
* Now has an attack speed multiplier of 160% (rather than 60% more attack speed).
}}
{{Version history table row|2.6.0|
* Damage reduced by 18% at level 1 of the gem, scaling to a 15% reduction at level 20 of the gem.
* Radius has gained 2 units on all of its ranges. (The damage area has increased from 12 to 14 units, the channelling targeting area has increased from 15 to 17 units and the release targeting area has increased from 17 to 19 units.)
* No longer gain increased area of effect radius.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.5.0|
* Blade Flurry's "More attack speed" modifier has been reduced from 65% more to 60% more attack speed at all levels. Blade Flurry's targeting range has been reduced by 16.6%, and the damage radius of slashes has been reduced by 14.2%.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.4.2|
* Added new Dexterity/Intelligence skill - Blade Flurry: Repeatedly strike at enemies in a circle in front of you while channelling, dealing damage to and around the struck enemy. The damage is continually boosted while channelling. You unleash an additional strike for each stage reached once the channelling ends. Requires a Dagger, Claw or One-Handed Sword.
}}
